Definition: excision, i.e. destruction; used only (adverbially) with prepositional prefix to extinction, i.e. perpetually
BiblicalUsage: The Bible's word here is tsᵉmîythuth, meaning excision, i.e. destruction. It appears 2 times in Scripture, including Leviticus 25:23 and Leviticus 25:30.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is simple: tsᵉmîythuth matters because God said it, and God wastes no words.
